name: Disco's RNG [Update] [In Dev]
desc:
📢 Disco's RNG (In Development) 📢

Prepare for an exciting adventure in Disco's RNG!
where you can roll special auras to impress your friends and other players!

🕹️ Features: 🕹️
- Quick Roll: Spend 30 Robux for faster rolls.
- Weather system: Unlock auras under special conditions!
- Auto Roll: Roll automatically even when you're away!
- A Variety of Auras: Choose from over 40 different auras.
- Explore the Map: Discover secrets, explore caves, and more.

Stay tuned for more updates! Disco's RNG is still in development, with many more features planned for the future!

We appreciate all the support from our players. Remember, just liking the game support us a lot!
